Dear Neil Sloane and OEIS Editorial Board,

I am writing regarding OEIS sequence A066010 (covering numbers C(v, 4, 3)).

For v=10, the exact value is C(10, 4, 3) = 30 (Steiner Quadruple System SQS(10), Mills 1979).

Our automated structured synthesis system (EvoByte) produced a self-contained, canonical cyclic certification of SQS(10) generated by 3 base blocks in Z_10:
(1, 2, 3, 7), (1, 2, 4, 5), (1, 3, 5, 8).

We provide this self-contained certificate and standalone zero-dependency Python verifier (runs in 0.24 ms) for OEIS cross-referencing and verification.

All artifacts, reproduction script, and Lean 4 formal proofs are publicly available:
https://github.com/AlexandreZanata/EvoByte

Sincerely,
Alexandre Zanata
EvoByte Project
